apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Your lightpaper.org API key (starts with lp_free_ or lp_live_). Optional — tools authenticate interactively via email OTP.

tools.name: publish_lightpaper
tools.description: Publish a document to lightpaper.org. Returns a permanent URL, quality score (0-100), and quality suggestions. Content must be markdown with at least 300 words and one heading.

slug.description: Custom URL slug (max 80 chars). Auto-generated from title if omitted.

format.description: Presentation format — choose based on the content's nature. 'paper': research papers, literature reviews, technical analyses — serif font, numbered sections, first blockquote as Abstract, academic tables. 'essay': sustained arguments, cultural commentary, longform narratives — elegant serif, drop cap, pull-quote blockquotes, ornamental dividers. 'post': practical articles, tutorials, technical writeups — clean sans-serif, callout-box blockquotes, prominent code blocks.

listed.description: If true, document appears in search results and sitemap.

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

authors.description: Author attribution. If omitted, the publishing account is not credited by name.

content.description: Markdown content (min 300 words, must include at least one # heading)

tools.name: search_lightpapers
tools.description: Search published documents on lightpaper.org. Returns titles, URLs, authors, quality scores.

query.description: Full-text search query. Omit to browse all articles (use with sort/author/tags filters).

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

tools.name: update_lightpaper
tools.description: Update an existing document. Only the document owner can update. Content updates create a new version (max 100 versions). Quality score is recalculated on content change.

listed.description: Set to false to remove from search results and sitemap

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

content.description: New markdown content (creates a new version)

tools.name: delete_lightpaper
tools.description: Delete a document (soft-delete). Only the document owner can delete. Returns 204 on success.

tools.name: list_my_lightpapers
tools.description: List all documents published by the authenticated account. Returns id, title, slug, quality_score, listed status, URLs, and timestamps.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update account profile fields: display_name, bio, and linkedin_url (shown as clickable badge on published documents).

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (e.g. 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/username/'). Makes the LinkedIn badge clickable on all published documents.

tools.name: get_gravity_info
tools.description: Get the authenticated account's gravity level details: current level (0-5), search ranking multiplier, featured quality threshold, verification badges, and instructions for reaching the next level.

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

tools.description: Get a public author profile by handle. Returns display name, bio, gravity level, badges, and their published documents.

tools.description: List version history for a document. Each version has a content hash, word count, reading time, and timestamp.

tools.name: list_credentials
tools.description: List all verified credentials submitted for the authenticated account.

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

tools.name: auth_email
tools.description: Send a 6-digit verification code to the user's email. Works for both signup and login. After calling this, ask the user for the code and call auth_verify.

handle.description: Unique handle (e.g. 'alice'). Used in author profiles at /@handle.

tools.name: auth_verify
tools.description: Verify a 6-digit code from the user's email. Returns account info and an API key. Use the returned api_key in all subsequent tool calls.

tools.name: auth_linkedin
tools.description: Start LinkedIn OAuth for login/signup. Returns an authorization URL for the user to open in their browser, and a session_id for polling. After the user completes OAuth, call auth_linkedin_poll.

tools.name: auth_linkedin_poll
tools.description: Poll for LinkedIn OAuth completion. Returns the API key once the user completes the OAuth flow. The API key is only returned on the first poll — subsequent polls return null.

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Start or check domain DNS verification. Call with domain to start (returns TXT record to add), call without to check status.

domain.description: Domain to verify (omit to check existing verification)

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

tools.name: verify_linkedin
tools.description: Start or check LinkedIn verification. Call with action='start' to get OAuth URL (user must open in browser), action='check' to poll completion.

action.description: 'start' to begin OAuth, 'check' to poll completion

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

tools.name: verify_orcid
tools.description: Verify an ORCID iD. Validates against the public ORCID API. Fully automatable — no browser needed.

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

tools.name: verify_credentials
tools.description: Submit verified credentials (degrees, certifications, employment) for an account. Evidence tiers: 'confirmed' (3pts, institutional API match), 'supported' (2pts, corroborating evidence), 'claimed' (1pt, user's word). Credential points combine with identity verifications for gravity: e.g., LinkedIn + confirmed degree (3 pts) = Level 3. Tiers can only be upgraded, never downgraded on re-submit.

api_key.description: API key to authenticate as a specific account. Overrides the default LIGHTPAPER_API_KEY. Use the key returned by onboard_pilot to act on behalf of that account.

title.description: Credential title (e.g. 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science')

evidence_data.description: API responses, URLs, or other verification data

credential_type.description: Type of credential (degree, certification, or employment)
